title: DOM
explain: The DOM (Document Object Model) is a tree structure that represents your HTML page in JavaScript. You can select HTML elements using methods like `document.getElementById()` or `document.querySelector()`, then modify their content, attributes, or styles. This allows you to make web pages interactive and dynamic.
code: Hello
exercise: Add a second button that changes the title text back to 'Hello' when clicked.
tip: A common mistake is trying to select an element before it's loaded in the HTML. Always place your `<script>` tags at the bottom of the `<body>` or use the `DOMContentLoaded` event to wait for the page to fully load.
